inlines.v: SUN'-BRIGHT, adjective [sun and bright.] Bright as the sun; like the sun in brightness; as a sun-bright shield; a sun-bright chariot. How and which way I may bestow myself To be regarded in her sun-bright eye. SUN'-BURNING, noun [sun and burning.] The burning or tan occasioned by the rays of the sun on the skin.
